name: IR Obstacle Sensor
fullName: Infrared Proximity & Obstacle Detection Sensor Module (LM393)
tagline: Reflective infrared sensor for obstacle detection, line tracking, and object proximity
description: The IR Obstacle Sensor module features an infrared emitter LED and a photodiode receiver paired with an LM393 comparator. When an object enters the detection beam, emitted infrared light bounces back and is detected, bringing the Digital Output pin LOW.

specs.outputType: Digital Switching Output (0 / 1) and Analog Raw Output (on 4-pin versions)

pinout.name: Digital Out
pinout.desc: LOW when obstacle is detected, HIGH when clear

wiringNote: Use the onboard multiturn potentiometer to adjust sensitivity based on ambient light conditions.
commonMistakes: Placing sensor under direct strong sunlight (sunlight contains heavy IR noise)
Using on pure matte black surfaces (black absorbs IR light and may not reflect)
Over-tightening the sensitivity screw causing the sensor to stay triggered continuously
